original_text: After having 4 Apple Watches I grew tired of the hamster wheel approach to activity tracking and goals. I was also tired of switching between watches because none of them could last a full day and night for sleep tracking. I purchased an entry level Forerunner and was blown away with how superior both the data and battery were. Intelligent data that was actually useful and only needing a charge once a week? What a dream. The user interface on the app isn’t quite as polished as Apple and has a bit of a learning curve but it’s not that bad; I picked it up quick. There is a lot you can do with building workouts, setting goals, tracking gear and the like. I feel like I use a lot of it but at the same time know I haven’t even scratched the surface really. I thought I would miss smart notifications and some functions more than I do, but I’ve actually enjoyed having a watch that is more watch than a very small not as useful phone on your wrist. Two years in now, absolutely no regrets I’d rebuy this Forerunner 100x over another Apple Watch. I still get nearly 7 days of battery and it works just as good as the first day I wore it. I’ll upgrade eventually but I can tell it won’t be caused by need like all my Apple Watches…it will be my choice. And I’m planning to get a higher end Forerunner that will give me even more useful data — worth every penny!
